description: This file defines a class that adapts the OpenAI audio transcription interface to IBM WatsonX. It includes methods for validating environment settings, transforming requests into the appropriate multipart form-data format, and constructing the request URL. Its purpose is to facilitate audio transcription requests to WatsonX following the OpenAI API specifications.

classes.name: IBMWatsonXAudioTranscriptionConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for IBM WatsonX audio transcription, inheriting settings from both OpenAI's Whisper transcription configuration and WatsonX-specific mixins. It manages environment validation, request transformation, supported parameters, and URL construction for WatsonX's audio transcription API.

methods.description: Validates environment variables and headers for WatsonX transcription, removing the 'Content-Type' header to allow automatic multipart encoding.
